text: Should the player and Android builds also drop F12 / north-button Instant evidence capture (paired PNG + state JSON)? docs/13-player-ux.md defines it as a rebindable player action and it is your playtest feedback path in just run / just client. This ticket currently keeps it in the player build and gates only scripted/scheduled capture, smoke flags, demos, render reports, and dev tools.
User (2026-11-13): Keep F12 instant capture in player and Android builds.
